record.reason: KairosAgent combines semantic reasoning and time-series forecasters with tool calls; experiments report forecast quality and end-to-end agent timing. The measured runtime includes task/tool interaction and does not optimize LLM serving; the application is time-series forecasting.
record.title: KairosAgent: Agentic Time Series Forecasting with Fused Semantic Reasoning
